$comment: Treatment models for the interactive mouth view (docs/plans/visit-story-v2-offers-design.md, section 1.12). The server (crates/aarogyam-domain/src/mouth.rs) resolves each step: 'done' and 'current' only when a record done here backs them (record_map), 'next' only for the one treatment in progress when a visit is booked, every other step 'usual' (shown under 'Usual steps' with no visit number, date or price). 'after_words' and 'recovery' are always shown under 'Usually' or 'What to expect', never as patient-specific. 'terms' maps a seeded procedure id or a procedure code to a model; a typed name is never read. 'medicaments' holds seeded vocabulary.json material ids only (DF5). 'material_appearance' maps seeded material ids to how they look; a clinic's own material takes 'custom_default' by finding. English only; reviewed by: pending (founder).

steps.words: The tooth is opened and the infected nerve is cleaned out
steps.after_words: Usually a temporary filling closes the tooth until the next visit

steps.words: A medicine is placed inside the tooth to settle the infection
steps.after_words: Usually the medicine stays for one to two weeks

steps.words: The cleaned roots are filled and sealed
steps.after_words: Usually the tooth feels tender for a few days

steps.words: The tooth is protected with a filling or a crown
steps.after_words: Usually a crown keeps a root-treated back tooth from breaking

recovery: Mild soreness for 2 to 3 days is common
Avoid chewing hard food on this side until the treatment is finished

steps.after_words: Usually done with the tooth numbed

steps.words: The tooth is filled and shaped to your bite
steps.after_words: Usually you can eat once the numbness wears off

recovery: Some sensitivity to cold for a few days is common

steps.after_words: Usually the numbness lasts 2 to 3 hours
Usually a gauze pad is bitten on for 30 minutes

steps.words: The gum heals over the space
steps.after_words: Usually the gum closes in 1 to 2 weeks

recovery: No spitting, rinsing or straws for 24 hours
Soft, cool food for the first day

steps.after_words: Usually the numbness lasts 3 to 4 hours

steps.words: The wisdom tooth is removed, sometimes in pieces
steps.after_words: Usually a few stitches close the gum

steps.words: A check-up to see the gum healing

recovery: Swelling for 2 to 3 days is common
Cold packs on the cheek help on the first day

steps.words: The tooth is shaped and measured, and a temporary crown is placed
steps.after_words: Usually the lab makes the crown in about a week

steps.words: The crown is fitted and fixed
steps.after_words: Usually the bite feels normal in a day or two

recovery: Avoid sticky food on a temporary crown

steps.words: Tartar is cleaned off the teeth
steps.after_words: Usually the gums bleed a little for a day
Usually a cleaning every 6 months keeps gums healthy

recovery: Some sensitivity for a few days is common

steps.words: The implant is placed in the jaw bone
steps.after_words: Usually a few stitches close the gum

steps.words: The bone grows around the implant
The crown is fixed on the implant
steps.after_words: Usually it looks and works like a natural tooth

recovery: Swelling for 2 to 3 days is common
Soft food on that side while it heals
